verification: Per venue-year accepted counts measured live on 2026-09-07 via api2/api.openreview.net (invitation + content.venueid filter, with_count). Shell groups that exist but carry zero submission notes (CVPR/ICCV/AAAI/ACL/EMNLP/NAACL) were removed: group existence is not evidence a venue runs submissions on OpenReview.

venues.name: ICLR
venues.note: 2023 and earlier live on API v1; ICLR 2023 stamps venueid on every active submission, so accepted must be derived from the venue string or Decision replies, not the venueid filter.

venues.name: NeurIPS
venues.note: Rejected submissions are never publicly readable; 2022 (v1) requires offset pagination - the v1 after-cursor silently drops notes.

venues.name: TMLR
venues.note: Rolling journal, no year in the venue id; never freezes - re-probe on every update.

venues.name: CoRL
venues.note: 2021-2022 exist on API v1 (optional backfill; outside the v2 registry range).
